content.short: Gemwallet is an open-source, multi-chain self-custody wallet supporting TON and major EVM chains.
content.description: Gemwallet is a modern, open-source self-custody wallet designed for the multi-chain era. It provides full support for the TON blockchain alongside other major networks like Solana and Ethereum. Gemwallet focuses on privacy and security, allowing users to manage their assets, stake tokens to earn rewards, and perform swaps within a clean and intuitive interface. By prioritizing transparency through its open-source codebase, Gemwallet offers a reliable and sovereign way for users to control their digital identities and assets across the Web3 ecosystem.
content.meta: Secure your multi-chain assets with Gemwallet. Open-source self-custody for TON on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
